Title: Azure Lab Services has an updated UI experience for students

Body.Content:
Azure Lab Services has an updated UI experience for students.  Some key improvements include:

  • A cleaner visual look for student labs.
  • Windows/Linux icons for labs based on the operating system used for the labs.
  • An improved start/stop/connect experience for labs.
  • Updated colors for the usage hours progress bar to provide more clarity around current consumption.

To provide feedback, go to the feedback forum.

If you have questions, go to Stack Overflow.

Learn more
